# Avocado part formats

*Generated by `PartFormats markdown` (sertoli); edit PartFormats.java, not this file.*

A part's folder in Avocado comes from its extension: `.mcu` mcu/, `.hsd` hsd/, `.had` had/, `.hud` hud/, `.pub` pub/, `.tph` telepathons/.

## Every part

| Field | Type | Required | What |
|---|---|---|---|
| `Homeobox Definition Type` | string | yes | names the generator: <type>HomeoBoxGenerator (not needed in a .hud of panels) |
| `Homeobox Name` | string | yes | the homeobox's name in the sperm |
| `Configurable` | list | no | what the page lets a recipe change |
| `Configurable[]:Name` | string | yes | the setting's path in the part, A:B for B inside A; Software:Parameters:<name> for a parameter's Value |
| `Configurable[]:Value Type` | string | yes | int, double, String, boolean |
| `Configurable[]:Required` | boolean | no |  |
| `Configurable[]:Default` | any | no |  |
| `Configurable[]:Per Unit` | boolean | no | true: differs from one unit to the next; never set in a recipe (the factory writes it at Send To DS) |
| `Configurable[]:Secret` | boolean | no | true: a password or key; never in a recipe or a Denome |

## For the palette (the page offers a part only with these)

| Field | Type | Required | What |
|---|---|---|---|
| `Display Name` | string | yes | the name on the part's card |
| `Description` | string | yes | one line: what the part adds |
| `Category` | string | yes | the palette group: Microcontrollers, Sensors, Actuators, Publishers, Telepathons, Human Interface |
| `Requires` | list | no | file names of parts this one needs in the same recipe |

## MicroController

| Field | Type | Required | What |
|---|---|---|---|
| `Component Name` | string | yes | the component dene's name |
| `Class` | string | yes | the framework's MicroController class |
| `Is Mother` | boolean | yes |  |
| `Software` | object | yes |  |
| `Software:Processing Queue Position` | int | yes |  |
| `Software:Async Request Delay Millis` | int | no | the asynchronous cycle's pause between requests |
| `Software:Async Execution Mode` | string | no | Continuous or Single |
| `Software:Parameters` | list | yes | the microcontroller's config parameters |
| `Software:Parameters[]:Name` | string | yes |  |
| `Software:Parameters[]:Value` | any | yes | of its Value Type |
| `Software:Parameters[]:Value Type` | string | yes | int, double, String, boolean |
| `Software:Parameters[]:Range Minimum` | number | no |  |
| `Software:Parameters[]:Range Maximum` | number | no |  |
| `Hardware` | object | no | Arduino boards only |
| `Hardware:Storage Manager` | string | no | e.g. SDCardManager |
| `Hardware:Time Manager` | string | no | e.g. GravityRTC |

## Sensor

| Field | Type | Required | What |
|---|---|---|---|
| `Sensor Name` | string | yes |  |
| `Port` | string | yes |  |
| `Microcontroller Pointer` | string | yes | the microcontroller that reads it |
| `Provider` | string | yes |  |
| `Reporting Value Dene Name` | string | yes |  |
| `Values` | list | yes | one per value the sensor reports |
| `Values[]:Name` | string | yes |  |
| `Values[]:Units` | string | yes |  |
| `Values[]:Value Type` | string | yes |  |
| `Values[]:Sensor Request Queue Position` | int | yes | the order the microcontroller reports the values in |
| `Values[]:Initial Value` | any | no | of its Value Type; default false for a boolean, 0 otherwise |
| `Values[]:Range Minimum` | number | no |  |
| `Values[]:Range Maximum` | number | no |  |
| `Container Page Identity Pointer` | string | no | the page its panel goes on; none: no panel |
| `Human Interface Panel` | string | no | the panel's name |

## Actuator

| Field | Type | Required | What |
|---|---|---|---|
| `Actuator Name` | string | yes | the actuator dene's name; its action list is "<Actuator Name> Actions" |
| `Microcontroller Pointer` | string | yes | the microcontroller the actions' commands go to |
| `Execution Position` | int | no | default 1 |

## SFTPPublisher

| Field | Type | Required | What |
|---|---|---|---|
| `SFTP Server Ip Address` | string | yes |  |
| `SFTP Key File Name` | string | yes |  |
| `Processing Queue Position` | int | yes |  |

## DigitalStablesPublisher

| Field | Type | Required | What |
|---|---|---|---|
| `Processing Queue Position` | int | yes |  |
| `Upload To DigitalStables` | boolean | yes | false: nothing is queued or sent |
| `DigitalStables Server` | string | yes | devicesheart's address, wss://.../mqtt |
| `DigitalStables Settings File` | string | yes | the file the factory writes at Send To DS (login, serial number, password) |
| `Prepare Evaluation Position` | int | no | default 25 |
| `Publish Evaluation Position` | int | no | default 26 |
| `Keep Command Requests Days` | int | no | the Mnemosycon rule; default 7 |

## TelepathonSupport

| Field | Type | Required | What |
|---|---|---|---|
| `Actuator Name` | string | yes | the receiver's actuator the delete commands go to (Annabelle Actuator) |
| `Panel In Page Position` | int | no | the Telepathon View Panel on the Home Page; default 2 |
| `Delete Telepathon Evaluation Position` | int | no | default 1 |
| `Delete Stale Telepathons Evaluation Position` | int | no | default 1 |

## HumanInterface

| Field | Type | Required | What |
|---|---|---|---|
| `Container Page Identity` | string | yes | the page |
| `Panels` | list | yes |  |
| `Panels[]:Processor` | string | yes | the panel generator |
| `Panels[]:Values` | list | no |  |

## HumanInterfacePages

| Field | Type | Required | What |
|---|---|---|---|
| `Panel In Page Position` | int | no | the Home Page Pills Panel on the Home Page; default 3 |
| `Show Map` | boolean | no | the Map pill (devices placed by their telepathons' Latitude and Longitude); default true |
| `Allow New Pages` | boolean | no | offer + New tab; default true |
